title: Accelerating Atom Simulations with Variable-Block Sparse Matrix Library
summary: Modern atomistic simulations increasingly employ localized orbitals to represent quantum operators, yielding sparse block matrices whose block shapes vary with chemical species and basis choice. Conventional scalar sparse formats store the entries of each block individually, obscuring this local structure and limiting the use of efficient block algorithms. We present VBCSR, a distributed sparse matrix library that preserves variable-size atomic blocks and accelerates the core linear algebra of large-scale atomistic simulations.
